Name: (JA) 8bit's Bakery
Author: 8bitcanvas
Description:
*This page was written by translating Japanese into English using Google Translate.

Json Assets用のレシピ追加Modです。
いくつかのパンのレシピを追加します（日本語・英語）。

絵に描いたパンという概念が好きなので作成しました。
もともとは自分用のため、自分が作成したカスタムNPCの好物も設定してあります。
材料にはPPJAシリーズ(現在のところ[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]Artisan Valley[/url]、[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]Fruits and Veggies[/url]、[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1670]More Recipes[/url])を使用しています。
レシピはガスから買うことが出来ます。

[b]v1.0.1以降[/b]
要望があったので、PPJA版とバニラ版を用意しました。
同じファイルに入っているので、好きな方を選択して使用してください。

Recipe addition Mod for Json Assets.
Add some bread recipes (Japanese/English).

I created it because I like the concept of bread in a picture.
Originally for my own use, I also set the custom NPC's favorite food that I created.
The ingredients are from the PPJA series (currently [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1926]Artisan Valley[/url]、[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]Fruits and Veggies[/url]、[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1670]More Recipes[/url]).
Recipes can be bought from Gus.
[b]
v1.0.1 or later[/b]
Since there was a request, I prepared a PPJA version and a vanilla version.
Since they are in the same file, please select and use the one you like.

I'm Japanese, so I don't know much about overseas bread.
The bread included in this mod is an image of bread from my point of view.
Sorry if I didn't understand.

[s]Also, the "Desctiption" is blank because I can't write English.
If you have any suggestions, please suggest them to POST and we may implement them.[/s]
Thank you for suggesting an English translation.
If you would like to add translations for other languages, please post!

[b]Providing translations:[/b]
